source_title: Planning application: 26/02084/F - Planning register | Planning register | Cherwell District Council

field_evidence.proposal: Demolition of existing single-storey rear extension and erection of replacement single-storey rear extension with associated new terrace and changes to fenestration. Removal of existing cement mortar to full extent of all existing elevations and re-point with lime mortar. Replace existing oil fired boiler with an air source heat pump. Demolition of existing detached garage and erection of replacement detached garage.
field_evidence.building_count_basis: one replacement detached garage; attached rear extension not counted as separate building
